title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 6 — WORLD 5: B1+ CHALLENGE & INDEPENDENT ENGLISH

targets.active_vocabulary: 1400+ words with collocations, phrasal verbs, idiomatic chunks and functional language
targets.skills: integrated B1+ accuracy, fluency, comprehension, interaction, writing and independent communication

grammar_focus: advanced tense contrast and aspect control
present perfect continuous and past perfect continuous
future continuous and future perfect foundations
modal verbs for probability, criticism and past deduction
third conditional introduction and mixed conditional awareness
advanced relative clauses and reduced clauses
reported speech with tense and pronoun changes
wish, if only and hypothetical language
discourse markers, cohesion and paragraph development
formal, neutral and informal register control

missions.title: B1+ Vocabulary Upgrade Lab
missions.focus: word families, collocations, phrasal verbs, idiomatic chunks and precise synonyms
missions.output: Use 45–55 target items accurately across a dialogue and connected paragraph

missions.title: Grammar Choice Navigator
missions.focus: tense, aspect and modal choices according to meaning and context
missions.output: Correct, explain and extend challenging real-life sentences

missions.title: Perfect Aspect Challenge
missions.focus: present perfect continuous, past perfect continuous and time relationships
missions.output: Describe ongoing situations, causes, duration and earlier events in an interview

missions.title: Future World Simulator
missions.focus: future continuous, future perfect, predictions and probability
missions.output: Plan a future scenario and explain expected developments and alternatives

missions.title: Past Deduction & Evidence
missions.focus: must have, might have, could have and can't have
missions.output: Investigate a mystery and justify conclusions from evidence

missions.title: Conditionals Beyond B1
missions.focus: third conditional introduction, mixed hypothetical meaning and alternatives
missions.output: Discuss past choices, consequences and what could have happened differently

missions.title: Complex Sentence Architecture
missions.focus: relative clauses, reduced clauses, conjunctions and sentence variety
missions.output: Transform short notes into coherent B1+ paragraphs

missions.title: Reporting & Passive Power
missions.focus: reported speech, reporting verbs and passive structures
missions.output: Convert interviews, announcements and information into accurate reports

missions.title: Register Switch Mission
missions.focus: informal, neutral and formal language
missions.output: Rewrite the same message for a friend, teacher and professional service

missions.title: Independent Conversation Core
missions.focus: turn-taking, follow-up questions, clarification, reformulation and natural fillers
missions.output: Sustain a 12–15 minute conversation with minimal scripted support

missions.title: Reading Lab — Decisions Under Pressure
missions.focus: main ideas, inference, writer attitude, reference and vocabulary in context
missions.output: Read 1000–1200 words and support answers with textual evidence

missions.title: Listening Lab — Everyday Voices
missions.focus: natural speed, connected speech, accents, implied meaning and speaker attitude
missions.output: Complete detail, inference and intention tasks from 10–12 minutes of audio

missions.title: Opinion Writing Studio
missions.focus: thesis, reasons, examples, counterpoints, cohesion and conclusion
missions.output: Write 280–350 words developing a balanced argument

missions.title: Real Storytelling Challenge
missions.focus: narrative control, atmosphere, sequencing, dialogue and precise vocabulary
missions.output: Write and present a complete story with a clear conflict and resolution

missions.title: Independent Travel Mission
missions.focus: complaints, changes, delays, negotiation, booking and polite escalation
missions.output: Complete a complex travel simulation while adapting to unexpected changes

missions.title: Health & Community Communication
missions.focus: explaining problems, asking for clarification, instructions and formal requests
missions.output: Handle multi-stage health, safety and public-service scenarios

missions.title: Study & Workplace English
missions.focus: meetings, deadlines, applications, feedback, emails and professional tone
missions.output: Complete a simulated meeting and produce follow-up written communication

missions.title: Five-Problem Independence Quest
missions.focus: negotiation, compromise, prioritization, clarification and decision-making
missions.output: Solve five connected problems without scripted language and explain each decision

missions.title: B1+ Integrated Skills Marathon
missions.focus: vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking and writing under realistic time limits
missions.output: Complete a full independent communication circuit with accuracy and fluency targets

missions.title: WORLD 5 MASTER QUEST — B1+ INDEPENDENT ENGLISH
missions.focus: final integrated B1+ challenge combining comprehension, interaction, production and real-world communication
missions.output: Complete extended reading, natural listening, independent conversation, 300-word writing, presentation and multi-stage problem solving

assessment.accuracy: B1+ control of common grammar with increasing flexibility
assessment.fluency: sustained communication with natural linking and manageable hesitation
assessment.comprehension: main ideas, details, inference and speaker/writer intention
assessment.production: clear connected speech and organized B1+ writing
assessment.interaction: ask, respond, clarify, reformulate and maintain conversation independently
assessment.independence: communicate and solve routine problems without translating every sentence
